title: Transforming Cities: Seeking more sustainable homes
summary: This C40 case study describes “Transforming Cities: Seeking more sustainable homes,” an urban initiative documented for Kuala Lumpur. It is included because it is located in the Global South. C40 describes the action this way: A community project in Washington DC that is giving back to locals and ensuring their homes are comfortable and energy efficient.

intervention.objectives: A community project in Washington DC that is giving back to locals and ensuring their homes are comfortable and energy efficient.

How data insights can empower property seekers and developers to make greener choices
